title: Coverage Start and Member Outreach Timelines for the Medicaid Managed Care Membership
content:
Service timelines for a new Medicaid Managed Care Membership: how far coverage may reach back, how long a member has to ask to be reimbursed for services paid out of pocket during that retroactive coverage, when Prairie Ridge contacts a new member, and how long a member has to report a change.

## Timelines by eligibility category

| Category | Retroactive coverage (calendar months before the application month) | Out-of-pocket reimbursement request (calendar days after the service date) | Welcome call (calendar days) | Health risk assessment offered (calendar days) | Change report (calendar days after the change) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult | 3 | 365 | 30 | 90 | 10 |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care | 3 | 365 | 30 | 90 | 10 |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | 0 (none) | 0 (no retroactive coverage) | 30 | 90 | 10 |
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | 3 | 365 | 30 | 90 | 10 |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 3 | 365 | 14 | 30 | 10 |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | 3 | 365 | 30 | 60 | 10 |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | 3 | 365 | 30 | 60 | 10 |

## Meaning of each timeline

- **Retroactive coverage.** The calendar months before the application month that coverage may reach back to. Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids has no retroactive coverage.
- **Out-of-pocket reimbursement.** The calendar days after the service date within which a member may ask to be reimbursed for a covered service paid out of pocket during retroactive coverage; 0 where the category has no retroactive coverage.
- **Welcome call and health risk assessment.** The calendar days within which Prairie Ridge places the welcome call and offers the health risk assessment. Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care has the shortest timelines, 14 and 30 days.
- **Change report.** The calendar days within which a member must report an address, income or household change: 10 in every category.

## Hypothetical reading

*A hypothetical Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care member and a hypothetical Prairie Ridge ABD Care member with the same start of the count*: the welcome call is due within 14 days for the first and 30 days for the second, and the health risk assessment within 30 days and 60 days respectively.
